sophie_prod: :loudspeaker: Heads-up: New Private data provenance & retention policy for VPC/on-prem customers goes into effect 2026-11-01. Full doc: https://go.redwood/onprem-provenance-retention
mark_compliance: Can you paste the short bullets so AEs and customer-facing teams can copy them?
sophie_prod: TL;DR bullets below. Keeping it short for email copy.
sophie_prod: • Default retention for diagnostic metadata (metrics + aggregated errors) remains 30 days.
sophie_prod: • Customers can opt into extended retention (90/180/365 days) for diagnostics and provenance artifacts under a paid retention addendum.
sophie_prod: • Model outputs and full request payloads are never collected by default; uploads require explicit customer consent and execution of the Provenance Addendum.
sophie_prod: • Provenance artifacts (config hashes, audit events, package versions) are generated locally; upload is opt-in and requires a signed consent token with TTL.
sophie_prod: • Region/residency limits: EU customers default to 90 days max unless a data-residency agreement is signed.
mark_compliance: Are there caps by region for extended retention pricing?
sophie_prod: Yes 1) US/ROW: up to 365 days available. 2) EU: up to 90 days by default; >90 requires explicit residency SLA. Pricing tiers will be in the addendum.
dina_support: Support implications:
dina_support: • For assisted investigations, customers must enable "provenance upload" and grant a scoped upload TTL.
dina_support: • We'll provide a one-time Assisted Provenance Review SKU for customers who want help collecting and interpreting artifacts. Add to quoting templates.
legal_priv: Legal notes: uploads require the Provenance Addendum and a consent token. For regulated accounts, deviations handled via legal_priv@redwood.com. We will not accept uploads that include plaintext customer data; any upload flow will include client-side masking recommendations.
jon_sales: One-liner for sales please?
sophie_prod: Sales one-liner: "Keep your environment auditable: enable optional provenance uploads and extended retention for deeper diagnostics and compliance evidence (consent required)."
docs: Docs plan: we'll publish customer-facing FAQ, sample consent flow, and CLI snippets by EOD next Tue. Example CLI to toggle local collection (no upload):
docs: ```
redwoodctl private provenance set --collect local --upload false --retain 30d
```
docs: To opt into upload with TTL:
docs: ```
redwoodctl private provenance set --collect local --upload true --consent "assist-review" --ttl 7d --retain 90d
```
legal_priv: Also: ensure we capture a consent audit record stored with the customer's contract; ops will surface consent tokens for the support workflow.
ops-bot: Announcement published: <https://go.redwood/onprem-provenance-retention|onprem-provenance-retention> by @sophie_prod at 4305556789
dina_support: Outreach: Support will email Private customers next week with steps to opt in and how the Assisted Provenance Review works.
sophie_prod: Action items: 1) Docs publish FAQ + CLI examples (due 2026-10-10). 2) Sales add SKUs to quoting templates. 3) Legal finalize addendum (due 2026-09-30).
jon_sales: I'll update the AE playbook and schedule a 15-min sync with support.
sophie_prod: Thanks everyone. No objections? If not we'll publish the customer notice tomorrow.
mark_compliance: No objections from compliance. :white_check_mark:
